description: A playback head that plays the whole of a Memory or MemoryCV buffer at any speed in either direction; it runs while touching a group of modules with a Memory or MemoryCV at the left-hand end

params.text: Sets the playback speed and direction, -10 to 10, added to the SPEED input; 1 plays at the speed it was recorded, 0.5 is an octave down at twice the length, and -1 plays backwards
Moves the playback head through the buffer by hand and springs back to centre when let go; playback stops while it is being moved
Latches; the head plays while it is lit
Sets the position the head takes the first time it plays after the patch loads, 0V to 10V across the buffer

inputs.text: A high gate plays and a low gate stops
Added to the SPEED knob to give the playback speed; with Use Speed as V/Oct set in the menu that sum is read as a pitch voltage
Each time this voltage changes the head jumps to that position in the buffer, 0V at the start and a shade under 10V at the end

outputs.text: Channel one is the position of the head as a phasor, 0V at the start of the buffer and 10V at the end; channel two is the position in seconds, which the menu can drop
The left channel of what is in the buffer under the playback head
The right channel of what is in the buffer under the playback head

notes: it plays nothing until a Memory or MemoryCV is the left-most module of the touching group it is in; the small light near the top edge is lit while it is attached
the buffer is silent until something writes into it: an Embellish or a Brainwash in the same group, or a file loaded into the Memory
the display below the CURRENT output shows the position in seconds and hundredths, or in minutes and seconds once the buffer passes 60 seconds
Randomize on the module's own menu sets the SPEED knob to a diatonic interval of whole-number ratios rather than to any value at all
menu: Fade on Move — silences the outputs while ADJUST or SET is moving the head; unset, playback carries on through the move
Use Speed as V/Oct — reads the sum of the SPEED knob and input as a pitch voltage, so that a sum of 1 plays at the recorded speed
Default direction is reverse — starts the head playing from the top of the buffer downwards
Zero the outputs when not playing — drops L and R to 0V when the head stops; unset, they hold the value they stopped at
Have 2nd channel of seconds on CURRENT — adds or removes the second channel of that output, which carries the position in seconds
Behavior at ends — what the head does at the top or bottom of the buffer: Loop Around carries on from the other end, Bounce turns round and plays the other way, Stop halts it
